title: Lemmatrix
description:
A program for phonological and grammatical analysis and linguistic documentation, for any language: lemmas with their tagged tokens (transcriptions, pitch and one recording each), paradigm matrices, utterances and texts, stored as readable XML.

Human readable, machine processable, ethically collected and shared linguistic data.
